The Finale is a special battle, accessible from the [[Memories]] screen after recovering all 18 Memories, in which [[CAT]] pilots [[The Cobalt]] to save her friends and end the loops.

It is deliberately tilted in the player's favor, and if you do manage to lose (such as by deliberately skipping turns) you will instantly restart.

Completing the Finale plays the credits. Completing it for the first time unlocks [[CAT]] for normal play.

==Phases==
Each phase consists of a fight against a ship containing a crystallized crewmate.

The deck starts with [[Basic Block]], [[Basic Shot]], [[Basic Dodge]], and 1 Energy per turn. Defeating a crewmate adds their card to the deck and increases Energy per turn by 1.

===Phase 1: Dizzy===
{{Enemy
  | title=G72 Artemis?
  | pilot=Dizzy
  | hull=1/1
  | shield=3/3
  | zone=Void's Cradle
}}
In this phase, the Artemis? shoots a laser from its central cannon, and it centers on one of the Cobalt's wings each turn. Defeating it adds [[Block Shot]]  A to the deck.

<br clear=all>
===Phase 2: Riggs===
{{Enemy
  | title=G72 Artemis?
  | pilot=Riggs
  | hull=3/2
  | shield=3/3
  | zone=Void's Cradle
}}
In this phase, the Artemis? grants itself 3 stacks of [[Autododge]] (Right) at the beginning of each turn, which can be handily burned by the Cobalt's four cannons, especially since it actively tries to stay on the left. Defeating it adds [[Evasive Shot]] A to the deck.

===Phase 10: The Boundary===
{{Enemy
  | title=???
  | pilot=???
  | hull=36/36
  | zone=Void's Cradle
}}
This ship(?) has 36 Hull. Its cannons take up the entire screen, and its first action is to give itself 8 Overdrive. This would definitely kill you instantly, but [[CAT]] counters this attack with the power of friendship: drawing one card of every color, and then [[Prism]], dealing 9 damage per cannon for a guaranteed OHKO. You are forced to use Prism; only 1 Energy is available in this phase, all other cards cost more, and the End Turn button is disabled.
